label: NONO::TFE3

sections.text: NONO encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in RNA processing and nuclear organization.
TFE3 encodes a MiT/TFE-family transcription factor that regulates lysosomal and metabolic programs.

The fusion retains the TFE3 DNA-binding and dimerization regions while altering its amino-terminal regulatory architecture, producing abnormal MiT/TFE transcriptional activity. NONO::TFE3 is a recognized TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma fusion.
